official_metrics.precision_recall_note: Ultralytics summary P/R are measured at its maximum mean-F1 confidence operating point, not the configured fixed confidence threshold.

matching_protocol: Predictions sorted by decreasing confidence; match to the highest-IoU unmatched GT of the same class if IoU >= 0.5; each GT matched at most once.

latency.protocol: batch=1; FP32; 20 warmups; all 270 validation BGR images preloaded in memory; CUDA synchronized; excludes disk I/O and model loading; includes preprocessing, transfer, prediction API, model, NMS and output boxes returned to CPU

latency_note: All validation images; one benchmark refreshes summary, latency and deployment evidence; other training must be stopped.

checkpoint_export.export_method: Ultralytics strip_optimizer; selected EMA preserved; original snapshot retained
checkpoint_export.stored_model_precision: FP16 floating-point tensors; integer buffers unchanged
checkpoint_export.validation_note: Reloaded exported checkpoint and reran full GPU validation in FP32. Official metrics, all 270 per-image predictions, fixed-threshold metrics, threshold sweep and failure cases exactly equal the saved pre-export evaluation.

privacy_sanitization.scope: Replaced absolute training metadata paths with paths relative to the Stage 3 directory.
